firstLines: Rachel Nguyen
Portland, OR | (503) 555-0121 | rachel.nguyen@email.com | linkedin.com/in/rachelnguyen
SUMMARY
Former middle school science teacher moving into instructional design. Eight years of planning lessons
for mixed-ability classes, plus two years building online courses for adult learners as a contractor.
Looking for a full-time learning design role on a training team.
SKILLS
• Instructional design: needs analysis, learning objectives, storyboarding, ADDIE, assessment design
• eLearning tools: Articulate Storyline and Rise, Canvas, Camtasia, Google Workspace
• Facilitation: live workshops for groups of 10 to 120, virtual sessions on Zoom
• Results: course completion up 30% and onboarding time down two weeks (see Experience)
EXPERIENCE
Cascade Credit Union (contract) Portland, OR
Instructional Designer Jan 2024 – Present
• Rebuilt the teller onboarding course in Rise, cutting time to independent work from six weeks to
four
• Wrote scenario-based compliance modules that raised first-try quiz pass rates from 64% to 88%
• Interview branch managers each quarter to decide which courses to update next
Lincoln Park Middle School Portland, OR
Science Teacher Aug 2016 – Jun 2024
• Planned and taught 7th and 8th grade science for about 140 students a year
• Moved the department's labs to Canvas, raising on-time lab report completion by 30%
• Coached five new teachers on lesson planning and classroom routines
PROJECTS
Volunteer onboarding course | Articulate Rise, Portland Food Share Sep 2023
• Built a 20-minute self-paced course for warehouse volunteers that replaced a weekly in-person
orientation
EDUCATION
Willamette Valley University Salem, OR
Master of Education in Curriculum and Instruction Jun 2019
